params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Default is 20, maximum is 100.

params.name: since
params.description: Unix timestamp to limit results to people created on or after this time.

params.name: until
params.description: Unix timestamp to limit results to people created on or before this time.

params.name: email
params.description: Restricts results to a specific person by email address.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of people in the project.
Creates or updates a person record and optionally schedules a survey to be sent to them. If the person already exists (matched by email or phone), their record is updated with any new properties.

params.name: person_identifier
params.description: Person identifier. Can be the person ID (e.g. 24248363), email prefixed with 'email:' (e.g. email:jony@appleseed.com), or phone number prefixed with 'phone_number:' (e.g. phone_number:+17132746524).

items.docs: Deletes the specified person and all information related to them, including surveys, responses, properties, Autopilot membership, survey history, integration links, unsubscribe/bounce status, and testimonials.

params.name: person_email
params.description: Email of the person whose pending surveys should be deleted.

items.docs: Removes all scheduled (not yet sent) survey requests for the specified person.
